title: Figure 44: "Growth of the Spaceways Routes" space infrastructure illustration
description: Dense black-and-white illustration of Earth surrounded by orbital routes and labeled facilities, including "Waste Storage and Processing Orbits," "GEO Platforms," "Lunar Spaceport," "Fuel Station Spaceports," "Orbital Transfer Vehicle," "Space Cruiseship," "Hotels," "Man-tended Manufacturing" and "Orbit Mapping Vehicle," with a steam locomotive drawn at right and the text "Where is our railroad to space! Where are the round trips." Captioned "Growth of the Spaceways Routes" and "From Dr. William Gaubatz"; document caption: "Figure 44. Where We Could Be If We Can Recapture the Engineering Confidence and Expertise of the Apollo/Saturn V Era."
